title: Microsoft Purview: analyse endpoint DLP evidence files in Data Security Investigations
summary: The briefing passes: its configuration paths, permissions, billing requirements and search limitations are supported by Microsoft documentation. It accurately reports the roadmap dates and distinguishes the documented search workflow from the roadmap's alert-launch wording.

claims.claim: DSI can query files captured by endpoint DLP evidence collection.
claims.quote: You can use endpoint DLP evidence collection in Data Security Investigations to query data captured by endpoint data loss prevention policies on onboarded devices

claims.claim: Investigators can add the associated file content to an investigation scope.
claims.quote: Select Add to scope to add the content associated with the search results to your investigation scope.

claims.claim: The evidence collection control is at Settings > Data Loss Prevention > Endpoint DLP settings > Setup evidence collection for file activities on devices > On > Select storage type > Microsoft managed storage.

Choose Data Loss Prevention.
Select Endpoint DLP settings.
Expand Setup evidence collection for file activities on devices and set the toggle to On.
Under Select storage type, choose Microsoft managed storage.
